help.text:
Snake Media

Choose Request to enter a title, Recommend to find something to watch, or My requests to check progress and change expiry.

Menus expire after 5 minutes of inactivity. Use /help to reopen.

Commands: /request, /recommend, /status, /serverstatus.

request.text:
Send /request followed by a title, or a plain media request.
Example: /request The Matrix from 1999

Review the poster before confirming. For TV, choose the season(s) you want.

expiry.text:
TV: choose Latest season, All seasons or a specific season, then Confirm. New episodes and future regular seasons are monitored.

Movies: 7 days after import. TV: 30 days per episode after import. Watching can shorten expiry to 7 days; it never extends it.

Choose My requests, select a title, then Extend or Keep permanently. Download cards also have expiry buttons. Include "keep for 14 days" or "keep permanently" in a new request to change its default.
